sender.bs: Reklama na društvenim mrežama ili internet trgovina s velikim popustima
sender.en: A social media ad or an online shop with big discounts

name.bs: Lažne internet trgovine s ogromnim popustima
name.en: Fake online shops with huge discounts

how.bs: Na Facebooku ili Instagramu pojavi se reklama s linkom na uvjerljivu internet trgovinu: brendirana roba po vrlo niskim cijenama, popust „samo danas“. Kupac upiše podatke kartice, novac nestane s računa, a roba nikad ne stigne. Najviše ih je u vrijeme sezonskih akcija, poput Black Fridaya.
how.en: On Facebook or Instagram an ad appears with a link to a convincing online shop: branded goods at very low prices, a discount “today only”. The buyer enters their card details, the money disappears from the account and the goods never arrive. They peak during seasonal sales such as Black Friday.

text.en: An ad with an unbelievable discount.

text.bs: Odbrojavanje: akcija ističe za nekoliko sati.
text.en: A countdown: the sale ends in a few hours.

text.bs: Link na nepoznatu stranicu, adresa malo drugačija od prave.
text.en: A link to an unknown site, its address slightly different from the real one.

text.bs: Plaćanje karticom unaprijed, roba ne stiže.
text.en: Card payment in advance, the goods never arrive.

text.bs: LIKVIDACIJA ZALIHA! Patike poznatog brenda sada samo 39 KM umjesto 189 KM. Akcija traje još 3 sata, besplatna dostava za cijelu BiH. Naručite odmah: [link]
text.en: STOCK CLEARANCE! A famous brand’s trainers now only 39 KM instead of 189 KM. The sale lasts 3 more hours, free delivery across BiH. Order now: [link]

en: ordered from a facebook ad and nothing arrived

bs: Cijene daleko ispod uobičajenih i odbrojavanje.
Adresa stranice s malim greškama ili neobičnim nastavkom.
Nema kontakta, uslova poslovanja ni iskustava drugih kupaca.
en: Prices far below normal and a countdown.
A site address with small spelling differences or an unusual ending.
No contact details, terms of business or other buyers’ experiences.

bs: Kupujte na provjerenim stranicama; adresu upišite sami.
Ako ste platili, odmah zovite banku radi blokade kartice i osporavanja transakcije.
Sačuvajte snimke ekrana i potvrde i prijavite policiji (122).
en: Buy from verified sites; type the address yourself.
If you paid, call your bank at once to block the card and dispute the transaction.
Keep screenshots and receipts and report it to the police (122).
